original_name: イフ ユーアー ゴースト コール ミー ヒアー !
source:
Welcome to the underworld's busiest call center! As Vanitas, it's your job to help frantic ghosts find their way — even when they're all talking at once. Lost souls, wild requests, and total communication chaos await. Keep your cool, listen fast, and prove you've got what it takes to survive six days in the afterlife's weirdest workplace!

Handle three or more calls at the same time, untangle overlapping conversations, and pick the right responses before the screen floods with chatter! Quick decisions, sharp thinking, and a little ghostly intuition will shape your ending. Can you become the ultimate call master?

If you're a ghost call me here!
translation:
欢迎来到地下世界最繁忙的呼叫中心！作为Vanitas，你的工作就是帮助疯狂的鬼魂找到出路——即使他们同时说话。迷失的灵魂、疯狂的请求和彻底的沟通混乱等待着你。保持冷静，快速倾听，并证明你有能力在来世最奇怪的工作场所生存六天！

同时处理三个或更多电话，理清重叠的对话，并在屏幕充满喋喋不休之前选择正确的回应！快速的决定、敏锐的思考和一点幽灵般的直觉将塑造你的结局。你能成为终极通话大师吗？

如果你是鬼魂就来这里叫我吧！
